mapper.select:
SELECT M.*, R.RoleName, R.SvcCode, R.SupplyYn FROM wizardn.tAthMngr M INNER JOIN wizardn.tAthRole R ON M.RoleUid = R.RoleUid WHERE M.LoginId = #{pLoginId}
AND R.SvcCode = (SELECT SvcCode FROM shopwizard.tCmpChnl WHERE ChnlCode = #{pChnlCode})
SELECT M.*, R.RoleName, R.SvcCode FROM wizardn.tAthMngr M INNER JOIN wizardn.tAthRole R ON M.RoleUid = R.RoleUid WHERE M.MngrUid = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wizardn.tAthMngr ( MngrUid, MngrName, RoleUid, CompCode, DeptCode, EmpNo, LoginId, Passwd, Email, MobileNo, PhoneNo, ProdApprovYn, ShopCode, State, Remark, RegistDate, RegistId, RegistName ) VALUES ( #{mngrUid}, #{mngrName}, #{roleUid}, #{compCode}, #{deptCode}, #{empNo}, #{loginId}, #{passwd}, #{email}, #{mobileNo}, #{phoneNo}, #{prodApprovYn}, #{shopCode}, #{state}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{registId}, #{registName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE wizardn.tAthMngr SET Passwd = #{passwd} WHERE MngrUid = #{mngrUid}
